summary: Built the slice-1 parts of the R1-R5 tidy-up: (1) docs/ui-tidy-up-plan.md, the R1 inventory that names every screen, panel, dialog, banner, the eleven top-bar controls and every shortcut, with its named group, default visibility, how it is hidden again, remembered state and entry point, plus the lazy/eager record, package decisions, R1 edge cases, gaps and the A2 per-screen running-app checklist; (2) src/features/apps/TopBar.tsx + TopBar.module.css, extracting the header into four named groups (Brand, Appearance, Create, Utilities) with Shell, Theme and the primary actions always visible and wrapping instead of clipping; (3) src/features/apps/UtilitiesMenu.tsx + UtilitiesMenu.module.css, one menu holding the advanced Editor, Updates, Refresh and Help commands, hidden until opened and hidden again on choose, Escape or click-outside, with an update-available badge so a waiting update stays noticeable; (4) src/features/apps/AppFooter.tsx + AppFooter.module.css, the slim persistent role=contentinfo status strip showing the app version only; (5) src/App.tsx now renders TopBar and AppFooter and code-splits EditPane, GitDrawer, ConsoleNav and the ThemeFinder body under Suspense, and src/App.module.css drops the moved header rules and adds the lazy fallbacks. Existing App tests were adapted where a control moved into the Utilities menu or a panel became lazy. Shortcut registry, command palette, Git branch-chip collapse and the terminal pass-through belong to the other slices of this build and were not touched. Verified with npm run lint, npm test (37 files, 364 tests pass) and npm run build. Slice 2 of 4. Added src/shared/shortcuts.ts: one registry plus matchShortcut/isAppShortcut for Ctrl+B (sidebar), F5 (refresh), Ctrl+Shift+P (palette) and Ctrl+Alt+T (theme), deliberately not matching the editor's Ctrl+S/N/O/W. Added the in-house CommandPalette (filter by name, shortcut shown beside each action, Escape/backdrop closes, choosing runs then closes) and its CSS module. GitBar gains an optional collapsible mode (collapsible + defaultCollapsed) that starts as a branch chip showing branch, dirty marker, ahead/behind and refresh, with a control that expands and re-collapses the Fetch/Pull/Push/Sync/Changes/History/Console tools; existing callers stay fully expanded. TerminalHost now uses the shared predicate in attachCustomKeyEventHandler, so the four app shortcuts reach the window while the focused terminal keeps Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V and every other key. Tests: shortcuts registry, palette, git chip collapse and terminal pass-through. Also reported here are the run's existing tests that cover R1-R3 (plan, footer, grouped top bar/Utilities) so every revision-1 requirement ID appears in the report. Finished slice 3: wired the shared shortcut registry into App (Ctrl+B, F5, Ctrl+Shift+P, Ctrl+Alt+T, all reaching the app through the terminal pass-through), added the lazy command palette with its action list, and made the app view's GitBar start collapsed to a branch chip. Added src/App.shortcuts.test.tsx (R2/R4/R5) and updated App.features tests to expand the git tools before using them. Full suite 387 tests pass, lint and build pass. Slice 4 of the revision-1 tidy-up: finished the App-level test updates. Added the missing AppThemesTestsUpdate piece in src/App.themes.test.tsx, an R3 test proving Shell and Theme sit in the visible Appearance group and are reachable without opening a dialog or the hidden Utilities menu (and that changing Shell and opening the Theme menu still work). Confirmed the rest of the design already in the tree and passing: grouped TopBar (Brand/Appearance/Create/Utilities) and UtilitiesMenu, persistent AppFooter, the collapsible git branch chip, lazy ConsoleNav/GitDrawer/EditPane/ThemeFinder/CommandPalette, and the shared shortcut registry. No Rust, src/api, permission, CSP or dependency changes. Ran npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) clean, npm test with 388 passing tests in 42 files, and npm run build successfully.
